args.prompt: One continuous shot: from a terrace on the 16th floor of a modern tower in Tel Aviv the camera glides forward through the open glass slider into a bright living room (pale oak parquet, cream boucle sofa, travertine table, jute rug, sand-grey kitchen, cream flush doors) and moves across the room toward the door. Steady smooth camera, photoreal, morning light, no cuts, no people, no text.
